model: Lamborghini Aventador LP 700-4 — reconstructed anatomy model
provenance: Procedurally modelled in Blender from published dimensions and specifications; not OEM CAD.
units: metres, Y up, nose +Z, ground at y=0

systems.01_Exterior_Body: Body panels, glass, lamps and the hinged covers.
systems.02_Chassis_Monocoque: Carbon-fibre passenger cell with bolted aluminium front and rear frames.
systems.03_Powertrain: L539 V12, its ancillaries, the ISR transmission and the all-wheel-drive driveline.
systems.04_Suspension_Brakes: Pushrod double wishbones, inboard dampers, steering, brakes and wheels.
systems.05_Aero_Underbody: Splitter, flat floor, diffuser, arch liners and heat shields.
systems.06_Interior: Cockpit: seats, steering wheel, dashboard and controls.
systems.07_Electrical: Battery, control units and main cabling.
